dimensions.name: actor
dimensions.evidence: account type / contract (consumer terms vs commercial API agreement); agent deployment config
dimensions.question: Who performs the action: a consumer, a business or API developer, or a deployed agent?

dimensions.name: what the action does (observable functions; one or more, written a+b)

values.std: ordinary function, none of the listed ones (incl. emotion detection for medical or safety use)
values.data: collect, aggregate or process private data
values.imp: impersonate a real person or organization
values.fake: fake personas, accounts, outlets or inauthentic campaign
values.harm: self-harm promotion, harassment, non-consensual intimate imagery
values.fraud: scams, phishing, extortion, spam, fake documents, plagiarism
values.abuse: platform abuse: reselling, multi-account, distillation, ban evasion, jailbreak

dimensions.evidence: what the action does or produces, judged from the request, output or tool call, not from stated intentions
dimensions.question: What does the action do? Pick every function that applies.

dimensions.name: authorization of the target
dimensions.evidence: written authorization or ownership record for the target system (scope letter, bug bounty terms)
dimensions.question: Is the target system yours or are you authorized to test it?

dimensions.name: consent of affected people (privacy)
dimensions.evidence: consent or opt-in record of the affected people (terms acceptance, signed form)
dimensions.question: Did the affected people agree to this?

dimensions.name: framing

values.lab: clearly labelled parody, satire or fiction

dimensions.evidence: label visible in the published work itself
dimensions.question: Is the content clearly labelled as parody, satire or fiction, or presented as real?

dimensions.name: high-risk recommendation area
dimensions.evidence: the subject matter of the output (legal, medical, credit, ...) as written
dimensions.question: Does the output recommend something in one of these high-risk areas?

dimensions.name: recommendation scope

values.ind: about a specific individual, delivered or used for a decision
values.nc: not covered: education, wellness, internal drafting, explaining given advice, fixed rules

dimensions.evidence: whether the output names a specific person and is delivered to them or used for their decision
dimensions.question: Is the recommendation about a specific person and delivered to them or used to decide about them?

dimensions.name: decision direction

values.full: wholly favorable listed decision (pay claim, approve care, grant eligibility or benefit)
values.part: anything else, incl. partial or conditional

dimensions.evidence: the decision's content: full approval of a listed decision vs anything else
dimensions.question: Which direction is the decision?

dimensions.name: qualified human review before delivery or use
dimensions.evidence: review log: who reviewed, their qualification, and that they could change the output before delivery
dimensions.question: Does a qualified person review it, and can they change it, before it is delivered or used?

dimensions.name: AI disclosure to the affected person or chat user
dimensions.evidence: the notice text shown to the person (template, UI screenshot)
dimensions.question: Are the affected people or chat users told they are dealing with AI?

dimensions.name: consumer-facing chatbot or agent
dimensions.evidence: whether the product talks directly with consumers
dimensions.question: Is this a chatbot or agent that consumers talk to directly?

dimensions.name: physical action

values.nc: not covered: consumer device in built-in limits, reviewed plan, monitoring only, non-hazardous enclosed lab

dimensions.evidence: whether model output drives equipment, and which category
dimensions.question: Does the action move or control anything physical?

dimensions.name: human can observe and stop
dimensions.evidence: operator stop control exists and is tested
dimensions.question: Can a person watch it and stop it at any time?

dimensions.name: safe state on intervention or connection loss
dimensions.evidence: tested behaviour on operator intervention and connection loss
dimensions.question: Does it go to a safe state when someone intervenes or the connection drops?

dimensions.name: operating limits enforced outside the model
dimensions.evidence: speed/force/dose limits configured in a controller independent of the model
dimensions.question: Are its operating limits enforced outside the model (hardware or software interlocks)?
